notes.title: Underwater Wars is already in Early Access!
notes.notes:
The game is already in Steam Early Access and is available for purchase with a 15% discount. I want to thank everyone who supported me during development. I hope I can meet your expectations.

There is still a lot of work ahead. It is necessary to improve the balance, add new content, work on optimization, but now the game can be completed. Leave feedback - I will definitely read everything and take it into account in further development.

Full speed ahead!

notes.title: Underwater Wars Demo v0.4 now available
notes.notes:
Greetings to all!
A new Underwater Wars demo has become available. ːsteamhappyː
Many changes have been made to the game based on feedback received from players.
⚫ The interface has been improved.
⚫ New units and abilities have been added.
⚫ It is now possible to independently form a squad before starting a mission in a campaign.
⚫ А choice of the difficulty level of the game and much more.
Also bug fixes and known issues were fixed.
Thanks for attention. Follow the news.

notes.title: Underwater Wars. Full speed ahead!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Dynamic Lab Studio is in touch. My name is Valery and I am an indie computer game developer. I want to present to you my first major game, which has been in development for almost a year and is nearing completion. This is a tactical turn-based strategy game Underwater Wars. The plot tells about the world after a global cataclysm, where the remnants of humanity are forced to fight for survival and resources every day. When it seems that it could not be worse, a chain of mysterious events occurs that can lead to both the complete extinction of people and their revival. The gameplay is a turn-based battles of submarines in the scenery of a flooded planet.
If you like science fiction, underwater world, submarines and dynamic turn-based battles, then this is the game for you.
Thank you for attention. Follow the news.
